tester_message_open_feedback_idx.name: tester_message_open_feedback_idx
tester_message_open_feedback_idx.where: "tester_message"."kind" = 'feedback' and "tester_message"."settled_at" is null and "tester_message"."removed_at" is null

tester_message_outcome_check.name: tester_message_outcome_check
tester_message_outcome_check.value: ("tester_message"."kind" = 'feedback' and "tester_message"."outcome" in ('yes', 'partly', 'no')) or ("tester_message"."kind" = 'reply' and "tester_message"."outcome" is null)
